items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Updates component sources, userobjects and the shared library csc_gh (installed to the Rhino scripts folder) from server. NOTE: CheckForUpdates must be True to check for updates AND to install updates! Switch on both to update everything. Updates come from the Grasshopper release that belongs to the server. UPDATE_CHANNEL (empty by default) may name a GitHub branch or tag for testing; it must match the remote name exactly.
